g.text: Distributed Cache: One Node Dies, Only Its Slice Falls Through
5-node ring. N3 is dead. Every other node keeps serving its own slice untouched.
to the next LIVE node: N4
-> fetch from DB, then populate N4
N3 drops off the ring. Only the arc between N2 and N3 -- its slice -- falls through to the database.
N1, N2, N4, N5 keep serving their own keys, untouched -- no coordinator, no global reshuffle,
just the ring's ordinary clockwise rule applied to one less node.
